headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to focus on fighting international criminal groups and trafficking.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells the federal government to put a priority on enforcing federal law against criminal organizations that operate across national borders. It also aims to prevent international trafficking. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and programs involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to make enforcement against cross-border criminal groups and trafficking a focus of their work.
They may face more federal enforcement efforts.
